# Proposal abstract

This fictional abstract is the only supplied portion of a larger draft. The remaining sections and cited papers are not available in this packet. No resource record or explanation from the researcher is available.

We propose to study deletion-safe retrieval for local research libraries. The intended contribution is to combine dependency invalidation with a query-time deletion ledger so that deleted items stop appearing without rebuilding the entire index after each deletion. We hypothesize that the combination can reduce update work while preserving deletion safety. Clarifying cases in which the extra machinery is unnecessary could also guide simpler implementations. Implementation and evaluation are discussed in sections 3 and 4 of the larger draft.
